title: A vendor on a deactivated term shows it as inactive until another is picked
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop switched off Net 60 while a vendor was still on it; another vendor is on Net 30.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} holds Net 60, which is deactivated. Vendor {Vendor-B} holds Net 30.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-03 Vendor A and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S6-03 Vendor B.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Vendor-A}'s vendor page.
  2. Open Edit Vendor.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
  4. Choose "Net 45".
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Open Edit Vendor for {Vendor-B}.
  7. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Credit term" reads "Net 60 (Inactive)".
  • Step 2: "Net 60 (Inactive)" is selected in Credit Terms.
  • Step 3: "Net 60 (Inactive)" is listed after the active terms.
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 5: the vendor saves on Net 45.
  • Step 6: it reads Net 30.
  • Step 7: Net 60 is not offered to {Vendor-B}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”
  • S6-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a vendor not already on them.”
  • Terminology: “Inactive → A deactivated term: absent from the customer and vendor pickers, still held by whoever had it, and shown as "{name} (Inactive)" on their card and in Edit.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
